---
loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader

kind-dependencies:
    - beetmover-source
    - post-beetmover-checksums-dummy

transforms:
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.build:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_deps:transforms
    - taskgraph.transforms.task_context
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_generate_checksums:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.job:transforms
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms

task-defaults:
    run-on-repo-type: [hg]
    name: generate-checksums
    description: generates checksums
    task-context:
        from-custom:
            - release-level
        substitution-fields:
            - run.stage-product
            - run.bucket-name
    run-on-projects: []  # to make sure this never runs as part of CI
    shipping-phase: promote
    worker-type: b-linux
    worker:
        docker-image: {in-tree: debian13-amd64-build}
        max-run-time: 1200
        artifacts:
            - name: public/build/SHA256SUMMARY
              path: /builds/worker/SHA256SUMMARY
              type: file
            - name: public/build/SHA256SUMS
              path: /builds/worker/SHA256SUMS
              type: file
            - name: public/build/SHA512SUMMARY
              path: /builds/worker/SHA512SUMMARY
              type: file
            - name: public/build/SHA512SUMS
              path: /builds/worker/SHA512SUMS
              type: file
    run:
        comm-checkout: true
        clone-with: hg
        sparse-profile: mach
        output-dir: /builds/worker
        bucket-name:
            by-release-level:
                production: "moz-fx-productdelivery-pr-38b5-productdelivery"
                staging: "moz-fx-productdelivery-no-7d6a-productdelivery"
    treeherder:
        symbol: Rel(GenChcks)
        kind: test
        tier: 1
    optimization: null

tasks:
    thunderbird:
        shipping-product: thunderbird
        attributes:
            build_platform: thunderbird-release
            build_type: opt
        run:
            stage-product: "thunderbird"
        treeherder:
            platform: thunderbird-release/opt
